name: Accursed Cargo (7-8)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean

disable: DC 28 Thievery check (trained) to open the crate with gradual release of its magical energy, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 24) to dispel the rune

items.name: Planar Depressurization
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the sigil on the crate

---
Effect The incomplete demonic pact causes the crate to explode. Bits of wood and energy from the Outer Rifts deal 2d10+11 bludgeoning,2d10+11 spirit damage to all creatures within 10 feet of it (DC 26 basic Reflex save).

text: A wooden crate bearing a chthonic sigil glows with a power contained within it.
